# VideoDB

VideoDB is a video infrastructure platform for storing, searching, understanding, editing, and generating video, audio, and image content.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/video-db/.

## Actions

- **Ask Collection** (read-only): Queue a grounded question-answer request over a VideoDB collection's Search V2 indexes.
- **Create Collection**: Create a VideoDB collection for organizing and searching media.
- **Get Async Result** (read-only): Check one VideoDB async operation by response ID.
- **Get Collection** (read-only): Get metadata for one VideoDB collection by ID.
- **Get Media** (read-only): Get metadata for one VideoDB video, audio file, or image.
- **Ingest Media**: Queue ingestion of a video, audio file, or image from an HTTP(S) URL into a VideoDB collection.
- **List Collections** (read-only): List collections available to the connected VideoDB API key and identify the default collection.
- **List Media** (read-only): List videos, audio files, or images in one VideoDB collection using one normalized media interface.
- **Rename Media**: Rename one VideoDB video, audio file, or image.
- **Search Collection** (read-only): Run synchronous semantic search over indexed media in a VideoDB collection.
- **Update Collection**: Update the name, description, or visibility of an existing VideoDB collection.
